data.name: Info_Graph_Title
data.value: Auto Graph

data.name: Info_Graph_What
data.value: Auto Graph draws how your C# project is built. It reads the files as text. It never builds or runs your code.

data.name: Info_Graph_Actions
data.value: Look at the graph of the latest saved version. Press Refresh to calculate it again. Open files and tasks from each node.

data.name: Info_Graph_Map_Title
data.value: Graph

data.name: Info_Graph_Map_What
data.value: Each box is a project. The arrows say which project uses which. You can look inside a project at its namespaces.

data.name: Info_Graph_Map_Actions
data.value: Choose a box to see its files and its tasks. Unfold a project to see its namespaces. Hide the packages or the relations of an AI with the switches.

data.name: Info_Graph_Coverage_Title
data.value: What could be read

data.name: Info_Graph_Coverage_What
data.value: It says how much of the project was read whole. What cannot be known without running anything shows as partial. Each gap gives its reason and its line.

data.name: Info_Graph_Coverage_Actions
data.value: See which projects are partial. Read the reason of each gap. See which saved version the graph describes.

data.name: Info_Graph_Propose_Title
data.value: Proposed relations

data.name: Info_Graph_Propose_What
data.value: An agent can suggest relations that are missing. It spends the usage limit of your plan, so it asks for your OK each time. What it suggests is drawn differently and never counts as read.

data.name: Info_Graph_Propose_Actions
data.value: Press Propose relations and see what will be sent. Give your OK only if you want to go on. Hide what it proposes with the switch.
